full_judgment: 36. The Supreme Court of India has expressed itself in the similar way in the case of Bharat Bank Limited Vs. Employees of Bharat Bank Ltd., reported in AIR, 1950 (S.C.) 188 when, in analyzing the attributes of Courts of law, it has observed that they derive power from the state and are exercising the judicial powers of the state.
